E_1: Energy of level n = 1, the ground level
N_1: Number of hydrogen atoms on level n = 1
N_2: Number of hydrogen atoms on level n = 2
N_II: Number of ionized hydrogen atoms (bare protons)
N_total: Number of hydrogen atoms, neutral and ionized together
Z_I: Partition function of neutral hydrogen, about 2 (the ground level only)
e: Euler's number, the base of natural logarithms
g_1: Number of states on level n = 1, 2
g_2: Number of states on level n = 2, 8
g_n: Number of states on level n, 2n²
